steps.expression: window.qaFill=function(batch,rpm,diameter,a,b){[['inp-batch',batch],['inp-rpm',rpm],['inp-diameter',diameter]].forEach(function(v){var i=document.getElementById(v[0]);i.value=v[1];i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));});while(document.querySelectorAll('#material-rows tr').length>2){var rows=document.querySelectorAll('#material-rows tr');rows[rows.length-1].querySelector('[data-role="material-remove"]').click();}while(document.querySelectorAll('#material-rows tr').length<2){document.getElementById('btn-add-material').click();}var rows=document.querySelectorAll('#material-rows tr');[['演示材料A',a],['演示材料B',b]].forEach(function(v,n){var s=rows[n].querySelector('[data-role="material-name"]');s.value=v[0];s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));var i=rows[n].querySelector('[data-role="material-percent"]');i.value=v[1];i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));});};qaFill('100','800','800','80','20');document.getElementById('btn-generate').click();true
